name: NVX136 motor imagery
_comment: The same paradigm wired to real hardware, and the shape a rig protocol takes.
One amplifier. The legacy console drove two NVX in lock-step through a chain of fixed
sleeps; that is deliberately not reproduced.
profile picks the timeout budget: `nvx` opens in about a second, `nvx136` needs five --
NVXOpenEx alone is 3.3 s on the media converter. Nothing here sleeps; every step waits for
the service to reach an observable state, and says which wait expired when one does.
impedanceMode is what the console's Impedance button switches to. It is a separate mode,
entered with recording stopped: one run is one recording is one file.
